title: TensorPlate InferRequest
description: Normalized inference-request payload used by the local HTTP endpoint and the LeRobot PolicyServer-compatible async path. Mirrors include/tensorplate/core/infer_request.hpp::InferRequest. Single-input vision is the n=1 case of `inputs`.

request_id.description: Per-request identity. Distinct from `metadata.action_chunk_id`; a single LeRobot async chunk may be served by multiple `request_id`s if the policy server retries.

endpoint.description: Target model identity or routed endpoint. The runtime resolves this against the active deployment.

inputs.description: Vector of named inputs. Validators reject duplicate `name` values.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated from request ingress through the result, log lines, and metric labels.

action_chunk_sequence.description: Sequence number of an asynchronous action chunk within an episode.

stale_after_sequence.description: LeRobot stale-request marker. Requests with `action_chunk_sequence` <= this value are considered stale and must be cancelled or expired.

extra.description: Free-form caller metadata. v0.1.0 transport: only string values.

deadline_ms.description: Relative deadline in milliseconds from the moment the receiver decodes this payload. Receivers convert it to a monotonic absolute deadline by sampling `std::chrono::steady_clock`. Absent value => no deadline.
